svg.title: Dreams function review by game system
svg.desc: 47 of 9551 function names checked. 1540 functions have evidence-backed system assignments; 8011 functions do not. Sections show evidence-backed associations with parts of Dreams. Every cell is a real function. Every section is filled using the same fixed square lattice and mapped-count area scale. Labels overlay cells; there are no reserved header bands. Green means name checked; amber means reviewed but unresolved; gray means not reviewed. Assignments are incomplete; full system totals and completion are unknown.

g.text: 1,540 functions mapped to parts of Dreams | 36 names checked
8,011 more functions still need system mapping. One cell = one mapped function; counts cover identified code only.
